# Mariposa Mental Wellness

> Private therapy practice of Kayla Martinez, MS, LPC (Arizona license LPC-24196). Based in Mesa, Arizona, with secure telehealth for adults anywhere in Arizona. Trauma-informed care using Internal Family Systems (IFS), EMDR, somatic approaches, and DBT skills. Self-pay at $165 per 50-minute session; superbills available for out-of-network reimbursement; free 15-minute consultation.

Office: in-person location to be announced; sessions are virtual for now. Phone: (602) 805-7017.
This website is not a crisis resource. In an emergency, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or 911.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/): Overview of the practice, approach, fees, and how to get started
- [About Kayla](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/about/): Kayla's background, training, and philosophy of care
- [Services](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/services/): Modalities used and the concerns Kayla works with most
- [Trauma Therapy in Mesa, AZ](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/trauma-therapy-mesa-az/): PTSD, complex PTSD, and childhood trauma
- [IFS Therapy in Mesa, AZ](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/ifs-therapy-mesa-az/): Internal Family Systems, also called parts work
- [EMDR Therapy in Mesa, AZ](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/emdr-therapy-mesa-az/): Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing
- [Therapy for Women](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/therapy-for-women-mesa-az/): Eldest daughter patterns, people-pleasing and fawning, perfectionism, maternal burnout, postpartum anxiety and depression
- [FAQ](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/faq/): Insurance, superbills, session length, telehealth, and first steps
- [Contact](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/contact/): Book a free consultation

- [Blog](https://mariposamentalwellness.com/blog/): Articles by Kayla on anxiety, trauma, perfectionism, and parts work
